subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: When a PR is evaluated in CI, the attribution gate shall fail the PR if an Argus-authored diff in it touches the authority contract, a governance document, or a file outside the drive's declared scope, returning a reason naming the path and the boundary.
fit_criterion: on the seeded PR fixtures (Argus-authored diff touching each protected-path class), CI fails with a reason naming the boundary; on a human-authored diff to the same paths, CI does not fail on this layer
